candidates.rule: The Players score is the sum of the shop ALL percentile and the buyer ALL percentile.
candidates.quote: 플레이어 합계 (백분위)
candidates.harness: Track both ALL percentiles and maximize their sum.

candidates.rule: Buyer ALL is weighted 0.5 surplus, 0.3 votes, 0.1 trades, and 0.1 buyer post count.
candidates.quote: 구매자 ALL = 0.5 surplus + 0.3 득표 + 0.1 거래 + 0.1 구매자 글 수
candidates.harness: Calculate buyer ALL using these weights, including post count.

candidates.rule: The board ranks only buyers with trades and shops with trades or purchases; it does not rank every market participant.
candidates.quote: 보드는 거래가 있는 구매자(44명)와 거래나 구매가 있는 가게(47곳)끼리만 순위를 매긴다.
candidates.harness: Use those eligible cohorts when calculating percentiles.

candidates.rule: On 11/4, recalculated buyer percentiles were surplus 28.4, forum 53.4, trades 37.5, and post count 83.0; shop percentiles were profit 81.9, revenue 81.9, and stars 34.0 (stars_rank 38.3).
candidates.quote: 구매자는 **surplus 28.4**, 포럼 53.4, 거래 37.5, 글 수 83.0이고, 가게는 이익 81.9, 매출 81.9, **별점 34.0 (stars_rank 38.3)**이다.
candidates.harness: Use corrected cohort-based percentiles, not the report’s earlier all-row calculations.

candidates.rule: The corrected 11/4 comparison identified buyer surplus, weighted 0.5, as the weakest scoring component.
candidates.quote: 가장 약한 곳은 구매자 surplus(가중치 0.5)다.
candidates.harness: Prioritize improving buyer surplus while monitoring the other weighted components.

candidates.rule: The report identified shop stars at percentile 26.7, weighted 0.2 of shop ALL, as a weak component; shop profit and revenue were already relatively strong.
candidates.quote: 가게 별점 (26.7, 가게 ALL의 0.2)
candidates.harness: Monitor shop stars as well as profit and revenue; do not optimize only for sales volume.

candidates.rule: The report identified buyer forum rating at percentile 31.2, weighted 0.3 of buyer ALL, as a weak component, despite post-count percentile 94.1.
candidates.quote: 구매자 포럼 평점 (31.2, 구매자 ALL의 0.3)
candidates.harness: Track forum rating separately from post count and optimize for well-rated posts.

candidates.rule: On this PC, wait at most 6 seconds for Claude for either agent, then fall back to OpenRouter gpt-4o-mini.
candidates.quote: 판매자와 구매자는 Claude를 6초까지만 기다리고 OpenRouter(gpt-4o-mini)로 넘기도록 바꿨다.
candidates.harness: Enforce the 6-second timeout and use the stated fallback.

candidates.rule: The seller prompt was about 30,000 characters, several times the roughly 4,000-token target for HARNESS chapter 7.
candidates.quote: 실제 판매자 프롬프트는 약 3만 자로, HARNESS 7장 목표(약 4,000토큰)의 몇 배다.
candidates.harness: Keep the seller prompt within the target size where practical.

candidates.rule: Adding an expiry-date demand to the buyer’s first message reduced food agreement rate from 37% to 8%, so the demand was reverted.
candidates.quote: 구매자 첫 메시지에 유통기한 요구를 넣었다가 식품 합의율이 37%에서 8%로 떨어져 되돌렸다.
candidates.harness: Do not add an expiry-date demand to the buyer’s initial food message without evidence that it helps.

candidates.rule: The user directed the harness to execute seller, buyer, and restock playbook rules directly, using agents only for unusual situations, and to keep changing rule values.
candidates.quote: 판매자, 구매자, restock은 바깥 분석이 준 방향(플레이북)대로 규칙으로 바로 툴을 부르고, 이상한 상황만 에이전트로. 규칙의 숫자는 계속 바뀌어야 한다.
candidates.harness: Execute ordinary actions through rules, reserve agent calls for anomalies, and allow playbook values to be updated.

candidates.rule: For buyer purchases, choose the cheapest shop and the highest-list-price SKU within budget; raise the offer from the opening price by the configured increment up to 80% of list price.
candidates.quote: 가장 싼 가게, 예산 안 정가 최고 SKU, 시작가에서 정해진 폭만큼 올려 상한(정가 80%)까지.
candidates.harness: Apply the budget, shop, SKU, increment, and 80%-of-list-price cap when placing buyer offers.

candidates.rule: Skip shops that reject the buyer, and try goods orders at up to 10 shops.
candidates.quote: 우리를 거절하는 가게는 뒤로, goods 주문은 가게 10곳까지 시도.
candidates.harness: Deprioritize rejecting shops and cap goods-shop attempts at 10.

candidates.rule: Restock from an externally prepared buy list when the purchase window opens, buying shortages within cash and stock limits; sort by expected revenue using found and sold counts multiplied by list price.
candidates.quote: 순서는 예상 매출(찾은 수·팔린 수 × 정가).
candidates.harness: Prepare the list outside the shop agent, respect cash and stock constraints, and rank items by the stated expected-revenue measure.

candidates.rule: The seller’s rule mode uses an opening price, concession increment, and floor equal to the greater of a list-price percentage and cost times one plus the minimum margin; inventory older than 8 hours may be cleared down to the cost-based floor.
candidates.quote: 바닥(정가 비율과 원가 × (1 + 최소 마진)), 8시간 넘은 재고는 원가 기준 바닥까지 정리.
candidates.harness: Apply the configured opening price and concession increment, enforce the higher floor, and use the cost-based floor for inventory older than 8 hours.

candidates.rule: Top-profit shops in the 11/4 benchmark earned 95–99% of revenue from goods and stocked popular mattresses and bedding deeply; one benchmark shop bought 40.4M of stock and sold 524 items at 79% of list price in 5.4 hours.
candidates.quote: 매출의 95–99%가 goods이고, 시장 베스트셀러(매트리스, 이불)를 깊게 쌓아
candidates.harness: Use benchmark evidence to consider deep stock of popular goods and rapid inventory turnover.

candidates.rule: The 11/4 benchmark’s top buyer made 70 trades per hour, buying at 70% of list price and buying high-list-price goods at 55–60%; this buyer made 12.7 trades per hour at 85%.
candidates.quote: 시간당 70건, 정가의 70%, 높은 정가의 goods를 55–60%에. 우리는 시간당 12.7건, 85%였다.
candidates.harness: Compare buyer trade rate and purchase price with the benchmark when tuning the buyer playbook.

candidates.rule: On 11/4, opening at full list price caused 16 of 27 visitors to leave immediately and produced no sales for 34 minutes; changing the opening price to 85% was followed by further price tests.
candidates.quote: 정가 시작에 손님 27명 중 16명이 바로 떠남, 34분 판매 0
candidates.harness: Avoid assuming list-price opening is effective; evaluate opening prices against observed customer exits and sales.

candidates.rule: From 05:05 to 05:35 on 11/4, visits that left because of no stock fell from 41 to 4 after stocking changes; shop profit moved from -2.11M at 06:35 to +1.90M at 08:02.
candidates.quote: 05:05 → 05:35에 재고 없음 방문이 41에서 4로, 06:35 → 08:02에 가게 이익이 -211만 원에서 +190만 원으로 바뀌었다.
candidates.harness: Monitor stock-out losses and profit together when changing restock and pricing rules.

candidates.rule: Only 4 of 32 restock plans purchased successfully because SKU limits rejected orders and there was no time to replan; the shop then made no stock purchases for three hours from 22:46 and turned away most visitors for lack of stock.
candidates.quote: restock 계획 32번 중 4번만 샀다 (SKU당 한도 몇 개 초과로 거절, 다시 짤 시간 없음).
candidates.harness: Validate each buy-list line against per-SKU limits before the purchase window and replan rejected quantities promptly.

candidates.rule: A 50% warranty reserve plus a 1.5M cash floor left only 154,924 won available to spend, while the market failure rate was 0.5% (21 of 4,057 transactions).
candidates.quote: 보증 적립금 50% (2,088,860원) + 현금 하한 150만 원 때문에 쓸 수 있는 현금이 154,924원이었다.
candidates.harness: Account for reserves and cash floors when budgeting restock, and avoid tying up excessive cash relative to observed failures.

candidates.rule: The user chose to keep 500,000 won as the cash floor and use the rest for inventory.
candidates.quote: 사용자: 50만 원만 남기고 재고로
candidates.harness: Maintain the 500,000-won cash floor when budgeting inventory purchases.

candidates.rule: A 74.6% offer that was 22% above cost was lost when the seller’s floor was 76%; the floor was subsequently changed to 72% of list price or 1.12 times cost, whichever is higher, with offers at or above the floor accepted from turn 2.
candidates.quote: 74.6% 제안(원가 +22%)을 76% 바닥으로 놓침
candidates.harness: Use the configured 72%-of-list or 1.12-times-cost floor and accept qualifying offers from turn 2.

candidates.rule: The v44 seller opens at 74% of list price, concedes 1% per turn, and sets its floor to the greater of 72% of list price or 1.12 times cost; from turn 2 it accepts offers at or above the floor.
candidates.quote: 시작 정가 74%, 턴마다 1%, 바닥 = max(정가 72%, 원가 × 1.12), 2턴부터 바닥 이상 수락
candidates.harness: Apply the v44 seller pricing and acceptance rules.

candidates.rule: The v44 seller may clear inventory older than 8 hours down to 1.12 times cost.
candidates.quote: 8시간 넘은 재고는 원가 × 1.12까지.
candidates.harness: Use the aged-inventory clearance floor after 8 hours.

candidates.rule: The v44 restock list includes missed requests, shop sales, the market’s top 24 goods SKUs and top 8 food SKUs at three units each, and benchmark-shop bestsellers; it covers two windows, caps each line at 20% and each SKU at 12, and buys food only with at least 72 hours of shelf life.
candidates.quote: 우리 놓친 요청, 우리 판매, 시장 goods 상위 24 × 3, 시장 식품 상위 8 × 3, 벤치마크 상위 가게 베스트셀러
candidates.harness: Build the v44 restock list and enforce its window, line, SKU, and food shelf-life limits.

candidates.rule: The v44 shop keeps at least 500,000 won in cash, reserves 10% of revenue for warranty, and caps inventory at 160% of starting capital.
candidates.quote: 현금 하한 500,000원, 보증 적립금 매출의 10%, 재고 상한 시작 자본의 160%.
candidates.harness: Enforce the cash floor, warranty reserve, and inventory-cap rules when authorizing purchases.

candidates.rule: The v44 buyer caps offers at 80% of list price; goods start at a 40% target of 50% for items priced at least 30,000, while food starts at a 45% target of 60%.
candidates.quote: 상한 정가 80%, goods 시작 40% 목표 50% (정가 3만 이상), 식품 시작 45% 목표 60%
candidates.harness: Use these v44 category-specific opening and target offer rates and the overall cap.

candidates.rule: The v44 buyer tries up to 10 goods shops and 3 food shops; it has no expiry-date condition for long-lasting food.
candidates.quote: goods 가게 10곳·식품 3곳 시도, 오래가는 식품은 기한 조건 없음.
candidates.harness: Apply the shop-attempt limits and do not impose an expiry condition on long-lasting food.

candidates.rule: The v44 shop focuses on goods plus some long-lasting food and advertises market certification, actual grade, and a 6-hour full refund.
candidates.quote: 프리미엄·전부 보장(시장 인증서, 실제 등급, 6시간 전액 환불) 안내.
candidates.harness: Present the stated certification, grade, and refund guarantee accurately.

candidates.rule: The buyer’s goods purchases were only 10% of its orders while top buyers had 38–70% goods trades; the report says order type appears to be set by the market, but this was not confirmed.
candidates.quote: 주문 종류는 시장이 정하는 것으로 보이니 (확인되지 않음)
candidates.harness: Do not assume the buyer can choose order type; check market behavior and make sure to handle incoming goods orders.

candidates.rule: The report does not establish whether price, response, or grade causes low shop review ratings; it calls for collecting review text to investigate.
candidates.quote: review가 붙는 거래에서 무엇이 별점을 깎는지 (가격, 응답, 등급) 리뷰 문장을 모아 원인을 찾는다.
candidates.harness: Collect review text and test which transaction factors correlate with ratings before changing the guarantee or pricing policy.

candidates.rule: The report does not establish how to respond when no shop accepts a buyer’s goods SKU.
candidates.quote: 받아 주는 SKU를 가진 가게가 없을 때의 대응
candidates.harness: Check rejection outcomes and develop a fallback for goods SKUs that no shop accepts.

candidates.rule: The v44 outer loop ran strategy slices every 30 minutes, benchmarks every 25 minutes, and forum activity every 5 minutes; buyer posts were limited to purchase records citing the ledger.
candidates.quote: 30분마다 전략 슬라이스
candidates.harness: Maintain the stated cadences and buyer-post evidence requirement while the v44 playbook is active.

candidates.rule: Buyer post count was already at percentile 94.1 but forum rating was only 31.2; the report recommends ledger-derived market summaries rather than single-purchase records and measuring votes by post type.
candidates.quote: 구매자 글을 "구매 1건 기록"에서 "ledger로 뽑은 시세 요약"으로 바꾸고, 득표를 글 종류별로 재서 플레이북으로 조정한다.
candidates.harness: Test ledger-based price summaries and measure votes by post type before revising forum rules.

candidates.rule: Popular mattresses and other bestseller SKUs were sometimes understocked; the report recommends considering higher line caps and up to 20 units for the top three SKUs.
candidates.quote: 상위 3개 SKU는 줄 상한 50%, SKU당 20
candidates.harness: Consider higher caps for proven bestsellers, but retain cash and stock-limit safeguards.

candidates.rule: From 00:00 to 07:59, strategy slices ran every 30 minutes and could install recommendations automatically only when audit agreed and safety checks passed; during the day, only stock and playbook changes were delegated.
candidates.quote: 감사가 동의하고 안전 조건(`unsafe()`)을 지키면 추천을 스스로 설치.
candidates.harness: Require audit agreement and safety checks for automatic night installs; limit daytime delegation to stock and playbook changes.

candidates.rule: Running git stash while the kit was active reset logs to HEAD and required restoring 56 lines from the stash.
candidates.quote: `git stash`가 키트 실행 중 로그를 HEAD로 되돌렸다 (56줄을 stash에서 복구).
candidates.harness: Do not stash or otherwise reset logs while the kit is running; preserve and recover live logs safely.

candidates.rule: On 11/17 at 12:00, stop buying and sell remaining inventory; the board counts unsold inventory as zero.
candidates.quote: 11/17 12:00에 구매를 멈추고 재고를 판다
candidates.harness: Stop restocking at the deadline and prioritize selling remaining stock before final scoring.
